ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey); visible high-intensity (white) pixels are limited to <5% of the fluke surface, primarily located at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark field distribution across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe and minor isolated points on the right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with a clearly defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the continuous trailing edge of both lobes, featuring irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical upward sweep with a concave trailing edge curvature leading from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of roughly circular high-contrast white pixels on the outer margin of the left fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-contrast white formations on distal tips; potential irregular structural loss at specific points along the serrated trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower central interface between the fluke and the water is obscured by high-intensity pixel noise caused by water spray and turbulence.
